Craft 6 and Laravel: What You Need To Know

SnapAttack

Product Strategy & Design

  • Challenge

    Complex cybersecurity startup SnapAttack envisioned a major product expansion to drive their next phase of growth and needed guidance on how to evolve their current product and UX strategy to meet their goals.

  • Solution

    Use in-depth research and design exploration, validated by their core team and current users, to develop a clear UX and product strategy.

  • Results

    A detailed blueprint of new features and a cohesive user experience that allows SnapAttack to make their expert cybersecurity product accessible to mainstream enterprise clients.

Cybersecurity made easy. Venture-funded cybersecurity startup SnapAttack had an early-stage software product and a solid, yet small customer base. They were ready to grow and looking to bring their expert-level cybersecurity product to mainstream enterprise-level users, but were struggling to turn their technical expertise into a product that everyone could easily use. Working in tandem with their co-founders, we identified user pain points, defined major feature expansions, validated our approach with current customers, and outlined a more intuitive user experience, giving SnapAttack the cohesive blueprint they need for their next phase of growth.

Areas of Expertise

Product Strategy Products Startups

Summary

We collaborated with SnapAttack to turn their high-level product vision into a concrete strategy for new features and a cohesive user experience. Now, SnapAttack is well positioned to grow sales to the mainstream cybersecurity market.
